name: onmixai-backend
description: Python/FastAPI service — NOT a Node project. Use make/uv, not npm. npm belongs in ../frontend.

scripts.preinstall:
node -e "console.error('
  backend/ is the Python (FastAPI) service — there is no Node package to install here.
  Setup:  make install   (from the repo root, creates backend/.venv on Python 3.12)
  Run:    make dev        (or: backend/.venv/bin/uvicorn src.main:create_app --factory --reload)
  npm/pnpm/yarn commands belong in ../frontend.
'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.dev:
node -e "console.error('
  Use the Python toolchain for the backend: run  make dev  from the repo root.
  (npm run dev belongs in ../frontend.)
'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.build: node -e "console.error('\n  The backend is Python \u2014 there is no Node build. Use make/uv. npm belongs in ../frontend.\n'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.start: node -e "console.error('\n  Start the backend with  make dev  (uvicorn). npm belongs in ../frontend.\n'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.test: node -e "console.error('\n  Backend tests:  make test  (pytest). npm belongs in ../frontend.\n'); process.exit(1)"
